kp_title: Identifying Regular and Irregular Singular Points
raw_html:
1.Identifying Regular and Irregular Singular Points?

(x−1)y″+y′+1(x−1)2y=0 Consider the differential equation given above. Which of the following statements are true?

  1. The functions P(x)=1x−1 and Q(x)=1(x−1)3 are analytic about x=1.
  2. The functions (x−1)P(x) and (x−1)2Q(x) are analytic about x=1.
  3. The point x=1 is an irregular singular point of the differential equation.
